More U.S. states are supporting Apple Wallet driver's licenses, though two have indicated they won't be doing so in the near future — and may never do so.

Florida and Rhode Island won't have Apple Wallet driver's licenses anytime soon, according to the relevant top officials

The number of U.S. states offering Apple Wallet driver's licenses continues to grow, and we have a fairly good idea of the three states coming next.

Many states may be planning to support digital driver's licenses at some point, but have simply never gotten around to it. Two states, however, recently made clear they have no intention of doing so.

Those two states are:

  • Florida
  • Rhode Island

Last week, Florida rolled out brand-new driver's licenses and ID documents. Many states use these opportunities to also roll out a digital version, but this time the state government made no mention of a digital ID whatsoever.

This isn't a coincidence, as Governor Ron DeSantis has been openly opposed to the concept of a digital driver's license. He posted the following on X back in November:

Florida actually had a digital ID program before, but abruptly ended support in 2024. It looks like it will take a new governor to change course.

In Rhode Island, Walter "Bud" Craddock discussed the topic of mobile driver's licenses ("MDL") on a podcast last week. Craddock is currently the president of the International Committee at the American Association of Motor Vehicle Administrators (AAMVA).

Mainframe Featured Comments

I'm of two minds about digital IDs. I understand the concern that if digital IDs are rolled out, more websites, businesses, and government agencies may start requiring ID to track and record us.

But they can already do that with physical IDs.

What gives me pause about this is that there are times when I genuinely want to leave my ID at home. I know I'm not doing anything illegal, so if I encounter an overzealous police officer, I'd rather not be forced to show ID.

My tech-brain says I want to leave my wallet and cards at home too. Even Walmart in Texas accepts Apple Pay now, and it feels like 99.8% of places I go support Apple Pay.

Like DeSantis, Craddock's term is ending in the coming months. So depending on his replacement, the state of Rhode Island may see Apple Wallet driver's license support at some point in 2027.

Here is the complete list of U.S. states that currently offer Apple Wallet driver's licenses, along with the three states expected to be next.
